description:
FILED s473w (Opus, 2026-09-09) from the #1502 CPAN-board census. This is the board's LARGEST remaining cluster: 55 of the 375 failing rows. Text::Balanced's `extract_quotelike` and `extract_tagged` return UNDEF (and leave `pos` at 0) for inputs real perl extracts. The dist's own t-files then fail their `substr($str, pos($str)||0, 1) eq ';'` assertion with `'s'` / `' '` where perl gives `';'`, and the scalar-context row with the whole untouched string where perl gives the extracted text. REPRODUCERS (module-level, no test harness; probed vs perl 5.40.3): use lib "$ENV{HOME}/.cpan/build/Text-Balanced-2.07-0/lib"; use Text::Balanced qw(extract_quotelike extract_tagged); my $str = "s{a}{b};"; my @res = extract_quotelike($str); perl: pos=7 next=[;] res0=[s{a}{b}] res1=[;] PCL: pos=0 next=[s] res0=[undef] res1=[s{a}{b};] my $s = " aaabbb
cccddd;"; my @r = extract_tagged($s, qr/<[A-Z]+>/, undef, undef, {ignore=>["
"]}); perl: pos=34 next=[;] r0=[aaabbb
cccddd] PCL: pos=0 next=[ ] r0=[undef] NARROWING ALREADY DONE, so the next session does not redo it: * `extract_tagged($str)` with NO options WORKS (pos=14, the right text) â so the tagged failure needs the qr// tag and/or the `{ignore=>[â¦]}` option; * the family is NOT #1567 (a /g match on an `@_` element losing pos): Text::Balanced opens every extract_* with `my $textref = \$_[0]` and drives `pos($$textref)`, and that spelling is probed IDENTICAL to perl; * `extract_quotelike` fails on both the `s{a}{b};` shape and the heredoc shape `<" is the same family. MECHANISM (one, WIDER than the module): an LVALUE BUILTIN under a compound operator or ++/-- stored NOTHING. The incdec macros (four copies of a literal place list) and %p-accessor-place-p (the compound family's place test) knew only element/deref places; `(p-pos x)` / `(p-vec ...)` / `(p-substr ...)` / `(p-array-last-index @a)` fell to the default arm, which BOX-SETs the new value onto a NUMBER = a no-op. Probe scratch/s523a/pr/c4f.pl (17 lines): pos($s)-- / pos($$r)-- (value and effect) / pos -= / pos++ / --pos / pos += clamps / pos through \$_[0] / pos($h{k})++ / vec += / vec++ / substr .= / substr++ / substr += / 2-arg substr x= / $#a -= / $#a += -- perl = tree, the base wrong on all 17. FIX (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, runtime only, no emission change): defsetf for p-pos / p-vec / p-substr / p-array-last-index (the writers p-setf's own arms use: p-pos VAR NEW, p-vec-set, p-substr ... NEW, p-set-array-length), the four added to %p-accessor-place-p, and the four ++/-- macros ask %p-accessor-place-p instead of their own literal lists (rule 11 -- the list they duplicated). GUARD Pl/t/regex-pos-01.t rows 29-45 (all 17 FAIL on the 8038fac6 extraction). ACCEPTANCE: Text-Balanced 06_extqlk 228/8 -> 236/0, 07_exttag 88/16 -> 104/0, 09_gentag 65/16 -> 81/0 (40 rows left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit); with #2900, every Text-Balanced t-file is now N/0 (01 02 03 04 05 08 also run, all pass).
subject: Text::Balanced extract_quotelike / extract_tagged return UNDEF where perl extracts â 55 of the CPAN board 375 failing rows, and NOT #237 (which closed) nor #1567
